title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
blurb: A deep, narrow mixture-of-experts decoder with dense prefix layers, partial RoPE, QK-norm and a multi-token-prediction layer, trained for agentic and reasoning tasks.
intro: GLM-4.5's architecture combines familiar parts in a particular way: GQA attention with QK-norm and rotary embeddings on only part of each head, a few dense layers at the bottom, MoE layers with a shared expert and sigmoid routing balanced by biases, and an MTP layer used for speculative decoding. The steps cover each part; the capstone builds a stack of dense and MoE layers.
